newsitem.title: USA: EIA report 1.7 m barrel U.S. drop in propane.
newsitem.headline: EIA report 1.7 m barrel U.S. drop in propane.

text.p: U.S. propane stocks registered a surprising 1.7 million drop for the week ending October 11, bringing U.S. total inventories to a low 48.7 million barrels, the Energy Information Administration reported late Thursday.

The EIA report showed a 900,000 barrel draw in the main trading hub of the U.S. Gulf Coast from the last report of Sept. 30. The hub's levels are now at 19 million barrels, about 31 percent below levels this time last year.
The Midwest fell 800,000 barrels to 22.7 million, about 1.7 percent below last year's figures.
The EIA is now on its winter schedule of weekly reports.
